Barsaat may teeron ki ye kiska janaza hai

1
Batlao musalmano ye kiska nawasa hai
Aey laal karo matam aankhon ko bandh karke
Lipti hui mayyat se ye fatema zehra hai

2
Hasnain tere gham may jo aansoo bahayega
Jayega wo jannat may zehra ka ye wada hai

3
Aey qalm bata tere kyun aansoo nikal aaye
Kya tune yateemo may qasim ko bhi dekha hai

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s = Path('src/data/lyrics/brsat-mein-tiron-ki-ye-ks-ka-janaza-hai.md').read_text()
_, meta, body = s.split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, digits in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [1, 4, 3, 3]
    assert [block[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]] == list(digits)
print('Both editions have one opening verse and stanzas of 3, 2, and 2 verses.')
PY"
